headings: ELEGANTLY TOKYO HAIR PERFUME 100ML (3.4 FL. OZ.)

jsonld_raw.name: ELEGANTLY TOKYO HAIR PERFUME 100ML (3.4 FL. OZ.)
jsonld_raw.description: A hair perfume infused with Pro-Vitamin B5, featuring the iconic Elegantly Tokyo fragrance. Perfect for layering with the Eau de Parfum for a deeper olfactory experience. Inspired by the balance between tradition and modernity that defines Tokyo, this scent blends the luminosity of white flowers and jasmine with the contemporary depth of akigalawood. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves. Floral | Serene, luminous, and structured.

rendered_description:
Description
A hair perfume infused with Pro-Vitamin B5, featuring the iconic Elegantly Tokyo fragrance. Perfect for layering with the Eau de Parfum for a deeper olfactory experience. Inspired by the balance between tradition and modernity that defines Tokyo, this scent blends the luminosity of white flowers and jasmine with the contemporary depth of akigalawood. A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves. Floral | Serene, luminous, and structured.
